1.text: Two ways to start the same morning.

2.text: Without Repeat, I open a spreadsheet and try to work out who I'm meant to follow up with.

3.text: With Repeat, I open Due today.

4.text: Every seller due for a follow-up is already on the list, with their status and how overdue they are.

5.text: Sellers I've scheduled for later wait under Scheduled until their date comes round.

6.text: So I start the day knowing exactly who to contact.

7.text: Repeat AI. A clearer start to the day.
